chunks: Abu Ali al-Ash'ari from Muhammad ibn Salim from Ahmad ibn al-Nadr from Amr ibn Shimir from Jabir said:

Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) would hasten to the mosque on Friday when the sun was about the height of a spear. And when it was the month of Ramadan, he would do so before that. And he would say, 'Indeed, the Fridays of the month of Ramadan have a superiority over the Fridays of the other months, just as the month of Ramadan has a superiority over the other months.'

key_terms.قِيدَ رُمْحٍ: about the height of a spear (a measure of time)

ai.seo_question: What is the virtue of Friday prayers in Ramadan according to Imam al-Baqir?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this hadith from Imam al-Baqir (AS) underscores the spiritual elevation of Friday prayers during Ramadan, noting his practice of arriving early when the sun was at the height of a spear. This establishes a hierarchical virtue where the Fridays of Ramadan hold a distinct superiority over other Fridays, mirroring the general excellence of Ramadan over other months. It serves as a key textual basis for the specific merits attributed to *Salat al-Jumu'ah* in the month of fasting.
